Since A<p-1, u0 is unique modulo p-1, and remaining uj∈[0,A] are unique base-p digits; all fibers and the binomial multiplicity histogram follow. Consecutive allowed digit blocks have differences Δ_k=p^k-A∑_{i<k}p^i, giving every gap length L_k=(p-1-A)p^k-1 with multiplicity A(A+1)^(b-1-k). Under scaling by Ap^b, reversed independent digit strings converge with coupling/Hausdorff error ≤p^-b to disjoint-map Cantor support dim log(A+1)/log p and Bernoulli measure of dimension [log A+(log 2)/A]/log p by cylinder masses and strong law. Independently multiplied cyclotomic degree factors as exact integers for (a,p,b)=(1,5,2),(2,7,2),(3,11,1); full predicted coefficient dict and all gap lengths matched. The all-parameter proof is digital/algebraic, not a finite extrapolation.

value.rationale: The arithmetic degree set of divisors of X^n−1 is the natural problem behind φ-practicality. In a complete infinite nonpractical regime this work gives all degree fibers, every omitted interval, number of uniquely represented interior degrees, and fractal distribution/dimension of a uniformly sampled divisor. These precise natural invariants can be used directly without requiring an unrelated downstream theorem.
